annotations.title: Find public MCP servers that work without auth

description: Search Agent Tested's live map of hosted MCP servers from the official MCP Registry for ones an agent can connect to right now. Matches the query against server name, title, URLs and tool names. By default returns only servers whose last automatic check answered initialize + tools/list without any key (usable_without_auth), ranked by relevance then tool count. Returns endpoint URLs, tool names and check dates. An automatic check, not a hands-on test or safety review.

query.description: Words such as 'github', 'weather', 'search'. Empty lists all.

usable_only.description: false also returns servers that needed sign-in or failed

name: find_working_mcp_servers
title: Find public MCP servers that work without auth
